en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Just as I thought, it only opens a little bit.
I'll have to get in from the Game Room.

<CLT=cltMIND>So this is where the shot put ball rolled to...
The weapon...that took Rantaro's life...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's just a monitor. Even if I investigate,
I don't think I'll find anything suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe there's a camera in here,
watching us... Maybe not.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.
